spec: The verification matrix behind docs/research/core-audit.md. per_game_capable is a proven static capability: true = at least one per-game save mode is established by source, shipped binary, or observation; false = absence is established; null = unknown. It does not state the active mode of a running installation — SavefilePlacement.granularity does that where supported. note is the concise evidence and limitation summary. save_options names the core options the audit found governing the file set and granularity; it is required for a multi-option verdict and rejected on every other one, because that verdict is exactly the claim that those options decide the answer — the resolver hands them to the caller in the 'core-multi-option' caveat so an unstated granularity says which options it depends on instead of reading as nothing-to-report. verified records, per arrangement (retrodeck / emudeck / bare), which versions the knowledge was verified against; null = never verified there. MAINTENANCE IS ENFORCED, not documented-and-hoped: strict loading requires the capability and note, a test asserts every rule card in core_oddities.json has an entry here, and the resolver attaches an 'unverified-version' caveat when a card is applied on an arrangement that is null here or whose live-read version differs from the verified one. core_library_version is the value the core's own retro_get_system_info reports (query_core), so staleness is checked against live reads on both sides.

azahar.note: [O] RetroDECK's prepared Citra save subtree suggests a deviation; no core-written save has been observed.

dolphin.note: [O] RetroDECK's prepared dolphin-emu save subtree suggests a different root; no core-written save has been observed.

flycast.note: [V-source/binary/live] flycast@1dac369 libretro.cpp:790-807 maps the option; oslib.cpp:38-67 builds the VMU path. Both placements observed live: shared vmu_save_*.bin under <system_directory>/dc, and 'All VMUs' writing <save_id>.<port>.bin into the redirected save directory (libretro.cpp:2142-2148), save_id being the disc's product number (emulator.cpp:838-841). [V-source] content without such an id — arcade, or a disc header stating none — is named after the ROM by the same function (oslib.cpp:62); the card carries both spellings and the answer states the condition. 'VMU A1' is [D] from the same path and covers port A1 alone, so its save spans two roots and states no file set. [O] which ports a per-content mode covers depends on the content platform (Naomi connects B1/C1, maple_cfg.cpp:246-253) — a dimension the card schema does not have.

genesis_plus_gx.note: [V-source/binary] libretro.c:1383-1500,3746-3765 proves frontend SRAM and per-game Sega CD BRAM modes; shipped strings match, but the upstream-to-binary binding is [D] and never live-observed.

mednafen_ngp.note: [V-live] RetroDECK 0.10.9b contains content-keyed SNK Gals' Fighters (USA, Europe).flash in the standard save directory.

mednafen_psx.note: [V-source/binary] beetle-psx-libretro@d6383bf writes every memory card into retro_save_directory (libretro.cpp:5234-5249): slot 0 either reaches RetroArch through the libretro SRAM interface as an .srm (libretro.cpp:5129-5145) or is written by the core as <stem>.<idx>.mcr (:2145-2163), slot 1 adds a second .mcr once a game dirties it (:2459-2485), and sharing swaps the content stem for mednafen_psx_libretro_shared (:5247). Which of those applies is what the three options decide; the shipped core registers their defaults.

mednafen_psx_hw.note: [V-source/binary] Same implementation as Beetle PSX at the same revision (d6383bf), reached through the beetle_psx_hw_ option prefix.

mednafen_saturn.note: [V-live] RetroDECK 0.10.9b contains three content-keyed Sega Rally Championship .bcr/.bkr/.smpc files in the standard save directory.

mgba.note: [V-live] Multiple content-keyed .srm files were observed under RetroDECK 0.10.9b's effective save directories.

mupen64plus_next.note: [V-live] RetroDECK 0.10.9b produced separate content-keyed 296960-byte .srm files for two games using different save chips.

neocd.note: [V-source/binary] neocd@5eca2c8: src/path.cpp:137-168 proves a per-content mode and src/libretro.cpp:214-215 exposes frontend save RAM. neocd_per_content_saves is registered as Off|On (src/libretro_variables.cpp:45), so it defaults to the shared <system_dir>/neocd/neocd.srm — written down because the core registers its variables at load, where no probe reads them, and it has no card to hold the value structurally. Load precedence and live behavior remain [O].

opera.note: [V-source/binary] opera-libretro@67a29e6 — the revision the shipped binary reports — writes its NVRAM per game or shared under <save_dir>/opera (opera_lr_nvram.c:130-152, :154-175) and exposes no RETRO_MEMORY_SAVE_RAM (libretro.c:430-444), so the nvram files are the whole save. Not live-observed.

pcsx2.note: [V-source/binary] The shipped 14d19f8 generation offers content-keyed <rom_stem>.ps2 cards when pcsx2_shared_memory_cards is disabled, and shared cards under the system directory when it is enabled; that per-content mode is not live-observed. The default sits in the card, which is where it can be read back (this core registers no options a probe can capture).

pcsx_rearmed.note: [V-source/binary] pcsx_rearmed@228c14e hands slot 1 to the libretro SRAM interface (frontend/libretro.c:2050-2068, :3483-3496), so RetroArch writes the standard .srm; pcsx_rearmed_memcard2 (frontend/libretro_core_options.h:152-165) is the core's only save option and switching it on adds pcsx-card2.mcd in the save directory, one card shared by every game (frontend/libretro.c:3500-3525).

pokemini.note: [V-live] RetroDECK 0.10.9b contains content-keyed Pokemon Party Mini (USA).eep in the standard save directory.

ppsspp.note: [O] The shipped sort override is known, but PPSSPP's libretro save subtree and granularity have not been established.

swanstation.note: [V-source/binary] The shipped 4d309c0 registers both card-type options; the libretro .srm, shared, game-code and game-title modes are established from source (src/libretro/libretro_host_interface.cpp:396-415, src/core/system.cpp:1457-1486). Not live-observed.
